What's new in 0.1.40

  • New: keep your Mac awake during file copies. Turn on "Keep awake during file copies" in Settings - Options and, in Automatic mode, a big Finder copy, download, or backup will hold off sleep even when no watched app is running - then the Mac sleeps once it is done. Tuned to catch heavy disk activity without false alarms; very slow transfers to a slow drive may not trip it.
